provenance.note: Same open_pdks pin and variant sky130-bandgap uses, so PVT/model provenance stays consistent across the 2AM Logic sky130 canaries (per this repo's CLAUDE.md).

notes: This file is the reproducibility pin for every record under sim/.
open_pdks_commit is the volare version hash for the sky130 PDK family;
sim/harness/pdk.py reads $PDK_ROOT/$PDK back through its symlink and
refuses to run against a different version unless --allow-pdk-mismatch
is passed (in which case the record carries the mismatch).
process_corners are the basic N/P device sections that actually exist in
the PDK ngspice library (verified against the .lib sections of
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice in this sandbox: tt, sf, ff, ss, fs,
ll, hh, hl, lh, plus the *_ll/*_hl/*_lh/*_hh compound sections and the
*_mm mismatch-switch sections). tt/ss/ff/sf/fs are the standard MOS/BJT
corners; ll/hh are the resistor/capacitor-only skew corners (they ride
on the nominal tt MOS/BJT corner and instead vary the passive parameter
set) -- carried over from sky130-bandgap's own empirical note on this
same PDK file. hl/lh and the *_mm sections also exist and remain
available to a future manifest that needs them, but are not added to
this pinned list until one actually uses them.
This repo's supply flavor (1.8 V core vs. a medium-voltage arrangement)
is an open question pending #1 -- nothing in this file encodes a
supply value; that lives in each experiment's own testbench manifest.
